description: Header file defining utility functions and templates for OpenGL/GLES entry points, including default return values for various entry points and helper functions for context identification.

classes.name: DefaultReturnValue<EP, ReturnType>
classes.description: Template struct for determining default return values for different entry points and return types.

methods.name: GetDefaultReturnValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for a given entry point and return type.

methods.name: CID
methods.description: Returns the context ID for a given GL or EGL context.
